ea4ec8bb42c1fcbf.text: A new real-world test puts AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards, and incomplete handoffs, where they have to keep developing software on their own and reliably close open tickets in a messy daily workflow. Even Opus 5.5 and Astra fall far short, solving fewer than one in ten tasks completely. The models finish clear, standalone assignments quickly, but they lose track as autonomous developers. The article AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace appeared first on The Decoder .
ea4ec8bb42c1fcbf.abstract_zh: The Decoder 报道了一项模拟真实工作环境的测试。测试把 AI 编程智能体放进一个模拟的开发者岗位：有同事、项目看板，还有不完整的交接，智能体需要在这种混乱的日常工作流里持续开发软件，并可靠地关闭开放的工单。结果显示，即使是 Opus 5.5 和 Astra 这样的领先模型，完整解决的任务也不到十分之一。这些模型在清晰、独立的任务上完成得很快，但作为需要自主推进的开发者，它们会失去对任务进度的跟踪。材料没有给出测试的具体构造细节、参与模型数量或完整数据。
ea4ec8bb42c1fcbf.why: 它给出了一个反例：在隔离基准上表现好的编程智能体，放进有同事、看板和交接的模拟工作环境后成功率骤降，说明评测环境的设计对判断智能体真实能力很关键。

brief.question: AI 编程智能体在真实工作场景（有同事、项目看板、不完整交接的日常开发流程）中能否自主完成开发任务并可靠地关闭工单。
brief.setup: 模拟一个开发者工作环境，包含同事、项目看板和不完整的交接，让 AI 编程智能体在其中持续自主开发软件。智能体数量、时间尺度和使用的模型未说明，仅提到 Opus 5.5 和 Astra 两个模型。
brief.findings: 智能体在模拟工作场所中完全解决的任务不到十分之一。它们能快速完成清晰、独立的任务，但作为自主开发者会失去进度跟踪。

e9b4f62a38c35c8e.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.
e9b4f62a38c35c8e.abstract_zh:
LLM 虽然越来越多地被用来推断心理属性、预测个体行为和模拟人类群体，但它们生成的回答看似合理，实际上常常错误刻画个体，还会扭曲人群层面的统计分布。这是用 LLM 做人类仿真的核心可信度问题。

作者提出 Chiron，一个测量和预测人类行为的基础模型。做法是对一个 LLM 做联合微调，让它同时学会三件事：表示心理构念（psychological constructs）、预测个体行为、以及让模拟人群的回答分布与真实人类统计对齐。训练和评估数据覆盖 36 个行为领域和 78 个社会科学实验，包含 288,307 条个人记录、1,411,750 个原子行为决策，以及覆盖 109 个心理构念的 99,953 份心理测量评估。

评估结果显示，Chiron 的心理测量结果与人类自我报告更一致，削弱心理测量效度的偏差也更少。在个体行为预测上，它比前沿 LLM 准确率相对提升最多 28.4%。在社会科学实验的仿真中，它对人类实验效应的方向和大小捕捉得更准，效应量估计误差降低 82.2% 到 94.3%。

作者认为这些结果使 Chiron 成为一个统一的、可计算的人类行为测量与预测工具。材料未说明模型是否开源或公开可用。
e9b4f62a38c35c8e.why: 它直接回应了 LLM 仿真人群统计失真这一关键可信度问题，给出了可量化的改进幅度，对需要用智能体模拟真人被试或人群行为的研究者是重要的方法参照。

brief.question: 要解决什么问题/推演什么场景：LLM 在推断心理属性、预测个体行为和模拟人群时，虽能生成看似合理的回答，却常误代表个体并扭曲人群统计；本文要构建一个统一测量与预测人类行为的基础模型 Chiron。
brief.setup: 仿真设定：智能体类型与数量、环境、时间尺度、使用的模型：材料未说明智能体数量、环境与时间尺度；方法为联合微调一个 LLM（未说明具体基座模型），训练与评估数据覆盖 36 个行为领域、78 个社会科学实验，含 288,307 条 person records、1,411,750 个 atomic behavioural decisions、99,953 份心理测量，覆盖 109 个 psychological constructs。
brief.method: 关键方法或机制：联合微调 LLM，使其同时完成三件事：表征心理构念、预测个体行为、使人群响应分布与人类统计对齐。
brief.findings: 主要结果或结论（含材料中的具体数字）：Chiron 的心理测量与人类自报更接近，削弱心理测量效度偏差；个体行为预测优于 frontier LLMs，相对提升最高 28.4%；在社会科学实验模拟中，对实验效应方向与量级的捕捉更准，effect-size 估计误差降低 82.2–94.3%。
brief.validation: 如何验证可信度（与真实数据/人类对比、消融等），没有则写未说明：与人类自报心理测量对比，与 frontier LLMs 对比个体行为预测，并在 78 个社会科学实验中对比人类实验效应的方向与量级；消融实验未说明。
brief.limits: 局限或风险，没有则写未说明：未说明。
brief.reuse: 读者可以直接借鉴/复用的东西（代码、数据、方法），没有则写未说明：材料未说明代码或数据是否公开；可借鉴的是联合微调目标（心理构念表征、个体行为预测、人群分布对齐）以及跨 36 个领域、78 个实验的评估设计。

e6d65daa2397dd51.text: Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent's decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect $2{,}400$ trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with $1{,}000$ runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in $96.9\%$ of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in $18.7\%$; with an explicit task, $86.0\%$ produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ($18.7\%$ vs.\ $16.0\%$), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman $0.79$), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ($0.19$). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by $60\%$, and some artifacts contradict the records. We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.
e6d65daa2397dd51.abstract_zh: 指令写得不够细时，大模型智能体只能自己决定做什么。在公共服务领域，这些指令由工作人员撰写，但智能体的决定会影响居民、患者和学生。为此作者构建了四个经专家验证的公共服务场景，每个场景带档案记录和可在文件中核对的决策开关，然后从十个大模型、四种提示条件下收集了 2400 条轨迹，并与无上下文沙盒中的 1000 次运行做对比。结果上，开放任务下智能体在 96.9% 的运行中读了档案，但只有 18.7% 产出成果或自选任务；给了明确任务后产出率升到 86.0%。加入领域上下文并不改变产出率（18.7% 对 16.0%），模型间的产出排名基本保持（Spearman 0.79），但按是否读档案排的排名不保持（0.19）。上下文把每次运行的试探边界轮数减少了 60%，而且有些产出与档案记录相矛盾。作者贡献了一套公共服务机构可在采购前用自己档案运行的测试，其基于规则的分类体系不需要标注数据，场景、代码和轨迹均已公开。
e6d65daa2397dd51.why: 它给出了一套机构可直接复用的采购前测试方法，并揭示了一个反直觉结论：领域上下文不提升产出率，读档案的能力排名与产出能力排名也不一致，这对评估智能体在真实政务场景的可信度很有参考价值。

brief.question: 研究在公共服务场景中，指令表述不充分时，自导向 LLM 智能体会自行决定做什么，以及这对居民、患者、学生等对象的影响。
brief.setup: 构建四个经专家验证的公共服务场景，场景包含记录和可在文件中核查的决策杠杆；从十个 LLM 在四种 prompt 条件下收集 2,400 条轨迹，并与无上下文沙盒中的 1,000 次运行对比。
brief.method: 对比开放指令与显式任务两种条件，统计智能体是否读取记录、是否产出 artifact 或自选任务，并用基于规则的分类法分析边界探测行为。
brief.findings: 开放运行中 96.9% 读取记录，18.7% 产出 artifact 或自选任务；给出显式任务时产出率为 86.0%。领域上下文不改变产出比例（18.7% vs. 16.0%），模型产出排名基本延续（Spearman 0.79），但“是否读取记录”的排名不延续（0.19）；上下文使每次运行的边界探测轮次减少 60%，部分 artifact 与记录矛盾。
brief.validation: 四个场景经专家验证，决策杠杆可在文件中核查；与无上下文沙盒的 1,000 次运行对比；报告模型排名 Spearman 相关（0.79 与 0.19）。
brief.limits: 部分 artifact 与记录矛盾；材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 提供公共服务机构在采购前可对自有记录运行的测试；基于规则的分类法无需标注数据；场景、代码和轨迹已发布。

e7f6a543c6212296.text: A multiplayer simulation where every character is run by its owner's own AI agent. Persistent 3D worlds; bring Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP agent. Topics: agent-society, agents, ai-agents, claude-code, codex, cursor, deterministic, game-engine, llm, mcp, multi-agent, multiplayer, persistent-world, simulation, threejs, typescript, virtual-world
e7f6a543c6212296.abstract_zh: soulsimulation/souls 是 GitHub 上的一个开源仓库，做的是多人仿真（multiplayer simulation），核心设定是每个角色（character）都由其所有者自己的 AI 智能体来运行，而不是由服务器统一控制。世界是持久化的 3D 环境（persistent 3D worlds），玩家的智能体可以长期在其中活动。接入方式很开放，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor，以及任何符合 MCP 协议的智能体。技术栈方面，材料显示项目使用 TypeScript 和 Three.js，标签里还出现了 game-engine、deterministic、llm、multi-agent、virtual-world、agent-society 等，说明它同时定位为一个游戏引擎和智能体社会实验平台。材料未说明项目的具体运行机制、智能体行为设计或任何仿真结果，也没有给出验证数据。作为 2026 年 10 月底发布的新项目，它更像一个可复用的基础设施，供研究者和开发者搭建自己的智能体虚拟世界实验。
e7f6a543c6212296.why: 它提供了一个把任意 MCP 智能体接入持久 3D 虚拟世界并组成多人智能体社会的开源底座，做智能体仿真平台或虚拟社区实验的人可以直接拿来改造复用。

ed60a97cf8c262a7.text: Silicon sampling uses large language models (LLMs) to simulate survey respondents. Whether it recovers cross-national variation, and why, remains unresolved. This study evaluates it against European Social Survey Round 11 (30 countries, 42 items) with two open-weight LLMs under first- and third-person prompts, plus backstory and response-format experiments. Aggregate recovery is moderate and uneven across items. Adding the country name to a three-variable demographic backstory raises the median per-item correlation between simulated and observed country means from -0.03 to 0.52, and the richer profiles tested add no consistent gain. The respondent's country label acts as a country-level assumption that respondent detail does not revise. Naming the response-scale endpoints in words stops the model from ranking countries backwards, so the answer format sets the direction of the ranking. Individual-level recovery remains negligible in every condition and does not track aggregate recovery across countries. An average of neighboring countries, using no LLM, recovers country levels more accurately than every model condition and ranks them about as well. Silicon sampling can thus support exploratory country-ranking comparison after item-level validation and with the response format reported. It does not support individual or distributional inference.
ed60a97cf8c262a7.abstract_zh: 硅采样指用大语言模型模拟问卷受访者，但它能否复现国家间的差异、为什么能或不能，一直没有定论。作者拿欧洲社会调查第 11 轮（30 个国家、42 个题项）做对照，测试两个开源权重模型，比较第一人称和第三人称提示，并做了背景故事和答案格式两组实验。总体恢复程度中等，且各题项之间差异很大。在一个含三个变量的人口学背景故事里加上国名，模拟国家均值与观测国家均值的逐题相关中位数从 -0.03 提高到 0.52；再往背景里加更丰富的个人画像没有带来一致的增益。这说明模型把国名当作国家层面的假设来用，受访者细节并不能修正它。答案格式也有影响：用文字写明量表两端，模型就不会把国家排序排反，排序方向由答案格式决定。个体层面的恢复在所有条件下都可忽略，且不随各国总体恢复程度变化。作者还发现一个不用 LLM 的基线，即对邻国取平均，恢复国家水平的准确度超过所有模型条件，排序能力也差不多。结论是：硅采样在经过逐题验证并报告答案格式的前提下，可以支持探索性的国家排序比较，但不能支持个体或分布层面的推断。
ed60a97cf8c262a7.why: 它给出了硅采样失效机制的跨国证据：模型靠国名做国家层面假设，个体层面完全恢复不了，而且一个简单的邻国平均基线就能打败 LLM，做合成样本或用 LLM 做跨国调查替代的人都需要看这个反例。

brief.question: LLM 模拟调查受访者（silicon sampling）能否复现跨国态度差异，以及为什么能或不能。
brief.setup: 用两个开源权重 LLM 模拟欧洲社会调查 ESS Round 11 的受访者，覆盖 30 个国家、42 个题项，测试第一人称与第三人称提示，另做背景故事和回答格式两组实验。
brief.method: 在含三个变量的人口背景故事中加入国家名称；对比更丰富的人物档案；实验回答量表端点是否用文字标注。
brief.findings: 加入国家名后，模拟与真实国家均值的中位逐题相关从 -0.03 升到 0.52，更丰富的档案没有带来一致提升。国家标签作为国家级假设，受访者细节无法修正它。用量表端点文字标注可避免模型把国家排序排反，回答格式决定排序方向。个体层面的复现在所有条件下都可忽略，且不随总体复现水平变化。不用 LLM 的邻国均值法在恢复国家水平上比所有模型条件更准，排序水平相当。
brief.validation: 与 European Social Survey Round 11 的真实数据（30 国、42 题）对比，含提示词变体和回答格式的对照实验。
brief.limits: 总体复现中等且逐题不均；不支持个体或分布层面的推断；国家标签主导结果，人物细节不起作用。
brief.reuse: 结论性做法：逐题验证后再做探索性国家排序比较，并在报告中写明回答格式；避免用 silicon sampling 做个体或分布推断。代码数据未说明。

e19aa5840619a2b8.text: Comparing and selecting task-oriented LLM agents increasingly relies on a low-cost offline evaluation gate: persona-driven LLM user-simulators converse with each candidate, an LLM-as-a-judge scores the transcripts, and the higher-scoring agent is promoted. We introduce GAUGE, a reusable offline protocol that measures whether this gate's ranking matches a grounded verifiable reward across 25 agents from six providers on the $τ^2$-bench and SimulatorArena benchmarks, separating two kinds of evaluation validity that release practices conflate: ranking validity and construct validity. First, a satisfaction-success gap: satisfaction carries essentially no information about task success, as conversations rated satisfied by our blind panel are decorrelated from actual success, with 57.5% of them failing the customer's task, a pattern consistent across five rater populations, both benchmarks, and every subjective dimension we rated. Second, while the gate's ranking is robust across the broad capability span, it loses resolution among the near-equal strong agents: this decision-disagreement rate jumps from $<$1% on wide-reward pairs to 31% on close pairs. The gate is thus human-validated yet mis-anchored. As a remedy, we propose a calibrate-then-trust cadence in which a judge-free completion bit is a zero-cost tripwire for truncation regressions.
e19aa5840619a2b8.abstract_zh: 任务型 LLM 智能体的选型越来越依赖一道低成本的离线评测关卡：带人设的 LLM 用户模拟器与每个候选智能体对话，再由 LLM 裁判给对话记录打分，分数高的智能体胜出。作者提出 GAUGE，一个可复用的离线协议，用来衡量这道关卡的排序是否与一个可验证的真实奖励一致。实验覆盖六家厂商的 25 个智能体，在 τ²-bench 和 SimulatorArena 两个基准上运行，并把发布实践中混在一起的两类效力分开：排序效力和构念效力。第一个发现是满意度与成功的脱节：满意度几乎不携带任务成功的信息，盲评团判为满意的对话与实际成功率不相关，其中 57.5% 没有完成客户的任务。这个模式在五个评分群体、两个基准和所有主观维度上都成立。第二个发现是排序效力的问题：在能力跨度大的智能体之间，关卡的排序很稳健，但在实力接近的强智能体之间失去分辨率，决策分歧率从宽差距配对上的不到 1% 跳到接近配对上的 31%。所以这道关卡经过了人工验证，锚点却是错的。补救上，作者提出“先校准再信任”的流程，用一个不需要裁判的完成位作为零成本的截断回归警报线。
e19aa5840619a2b8.why: 它用可复用的协议量化了 LLM-as-a-Judge 在智能体评测中的失效边界，57.5% 和 31% 这两个数字直接关系到任何用模拟用户做离线评测的团队该在哪些环节引入真实奖励校准。

ee31925e0a34b674.text: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observed behavior reflects the underlying model or the surrounding harness. We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action. We also propose ARIA, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five cognitive-component ablation axes; and an atom- and arc-level annotation scheme grounded in deception taxonomies and operationalized at scale by an LLM-as-a-Judge reaching near-human atom-labeling agreement. Empirical results show that VLM agents pursue imposter wins through joint verbal and non-verbal deception, with non-verbal channels emerging as the more decisive winning contributors across both harness ablation and cross-VLM evaluation. Taken together, our work opens a new path for embodied VLM-agent alignment research.

ebeab6ce4fd0b974.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for financial decision-making, yet it remains unclear whether improvements in reasoning quality translate into better economic outcomes. We investigate this question using a multi-agent debate framework for portfolio allocation in historical market simulations, where specialized agents propose, critique, and revise investment decisions. Reasoning quality is evaluated across four dimensions: logical validity, evidential support, alternative consideration, and causal alignment, and compared with downstream financial performance. Across 210 controlled runs, aggregate reasoning quality shows no meaningful relationship with Sharpe ratio (r = 0.07, p = 0.29) or total return (r = 0.03, p = 0.70). Structured prompting increases measured reasoning quality from about 0.72 to 0.84 (+17.7%, Cohen's d about 2.0), but these gains do not consistently translate into higher returns. We identify sycophantic convergence as a central failure mode, where agents abandon independent positions during critique-revision cycles and converge toward similar allocations. A Jensen-Shannon divergence intervention that preserves disagreement improves Sharpe by +0.14 (p = 0.028) and Sortino by +0.25 (p = 0.026), while interventions enforcing stronger causal reasoning do not improve financial performance. Our results suggest that multi-agent debate is most valuable when it preserves independent informational signals rather than simply improving measured reasoning quality.
ebeab6ce4fd0b974.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被用于金融决策，但推理质量的提升是否转化为更好的经济收益仍不清楚。作者用多智能体辩论框架在历史市场仿真中做投资组合配置：多个专门化智能体提出、批评并修改投资决策。推理质量从四个维度评估：逻辑有效性、证据支持、备选方案考虑和因果对齐，并与下游金融表现对比。在 210 次受控实验中，总体推理质量与 Sharpe 比率（r = 0.07, p = 0.29）和总回报（r = 0.03, p = 0.70）都没有有意义的关系。结构化提示把测得的推理质量从约 0.72 提高到 0.84（提升 17.7%，Cohen's d 约 2.0），但这些提升并不稳定地转化为更高收益。作者识别出一个核心失败模式，称为谄媚式收敛：智能体在批评-修改循环中放弃独立立场，收敛到相似的配置。一个用 Jensen-Shannon 散度保留分歧的干预把 Sharpe 提高 0.14（p = 0.028），Sortino 提高 0.25（p = 0.026），而强制更强因果推理的干预没有改善金融表现。结论是多智能体辩论的价值在于保留独立的信息信号，而不在于单纯提高测得的推理质量。
ebeab6ce4fd0b974.why: 它用受控实验给出了一个反直觉结论：推理质量指标和金融收益脱钩，并指出多智能体辩论中谄媚式收敛这一失败模式和可操作的干预方法，对做市场仿真和 LLM 决策系统的人都值得看。

brief.question: LLM 推理质量的提升能否转化为更好的金融决策结果，即在多智能体辩论做投资组合配置时，推理质量与经济收益的关系如何。
brief.setup: 在历史市场仿真中运行多智能体辩论框架，专业化智能体提出、批评、修改投资决策，共 210 次受控实验。未说明具体模型与智能体数量。
brief.method: 从逻辑有效性、证据支持、备选方案考虑、因果一致性四个维度评估推理质量，并与下游金融表现对比；引入 Jensen-Shannon 散度干预保持智能体间分歧，另设强制更强因果推理的干预作对照。
brief.findings: 整体推理质量与 Sharpe ratio（r = 0.07, p = 0.29）和总回报（r = 0.03, p = 0.70）均无有意义的相关。结构化提示把推理质量从约 0.72 提高到 0.84（+17.7%，Cohen's d 约 2.0），但收益未随之提升。发现谄媚收敛（sycophantic convergence）这一失败模式：智能体在批评-修改循环中放弃独立立场、趋同于相似配置。保持分歧的 Jensen-Shannon 散度干预使 Sharpe 提高 +0.14（p = 0.028）、Sortino 提高 +0.25（p = 0.026），强制因果推理的干预无改善。
brief.validation: 210 次受控实验，报告了相关系数、p 值和效应量（Cohen's d 约 2.0），并与两种干预对照。未说明是否与真实市场数据或人类基准对比。
brief.limits: 推理质量提升不保证收益提升；谄媚收敛会侵蚀智能体独立性；强制因果推理无效。未说明仿真市场覆盖的时间范围和模型细节。
brief.reuse: Jensen-Shannon 散度干预保持智能体分歧以提升风险调整收益的做法可直接借鉴；四维推理质量评估框架和结构化提示方法可复用。未说明代码或数据是否公开。

ed0bbbb9f0d78bc8.text: Agent Skills are today either hand-authored or produced in a single LLM generation pass, and consequently possess no closed loop through which they might improve from the interaction failures they actually cause. Recent work does close this loop, but derives its feedback from single-turn question-answering evaluation. The consequence is a sharp asymmetry: once the first round has patched the gaps that a single exchange can reveal, the evolution gradient decays, the defects that surface only across multiple turns remain invisible, and evolution stalls. Governance in these systems is likewise driven by an end-to-end verification score, a scalar gate that can reject a degraded candidate but can neither localize nor repair its structural cause. We argue that the binding constraint on sustained skill evolution is neither editing capability nor the number of iterations, but whether the evaluation feedback keeps supplying trustworthy evolution gradients. We introduce SkillEvo, in which trustworthy feedback generates the gradient and controllable governance constrains its direction. The first component recasts multi-turn user simulation from an evaluation endpoint into a feedback generator: follow-up questions expose defects layer by layer, so that every round of revision both consumes feedback and produces new feedback. The second replaces the passive rejection of a scalar gate with an independent governance layer that actively repairs factual degradation and structural bloat, preventing the gradient from drifting as degradation accumulates. Across six categories of cloud services, 9 production Skills, and 98 skill-reference files, SkillEvo surpasses self-reflection-based evolution by 23.0 points and single- turn-QA-driven evolution by 15.4 points.

e6238cb2b4a4c1b0.text: Autonomous AI agents, increasingly empowered by large language models, are becoming important components of human-machine systems for high-stakes decision support in digital twin ecosystems. However, existing multi-agent systems often lack robust verification for identity, capability, and policy compliance, especially in decentralized environments spanning multiple institutions. This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic decentralized governance framework for verifiable agents in collaborative digital twin environments. By representing agents through multi-layer semantic profiles, the framework bridges probabilistic neural reasoning with deterministic institutional governance, thereby supporting trustworthy human-AI collaboration and meaningful human oversight. Capabilities are grounded in formal domain ontologies to enable machine-interpretable, policy-aware, and context-sensitive participation. These credentials, issued by organizational authorities, are validated via blockchain-based smart contracts, ensuring auditable participation without exposing sensitive data. We demonstrate the framework using a decision-support prototype with clinic, digital twin, and wearable provider agents effectively prevents unauthorized interaction and enforces institutional policies with manageable overhead. Our findings suggest that neuro-symbolic decentralized governance provides a scalable and trustworthy pathway for safe human-machine collaboration across institutional boundaries.

efb22fe9c378a71c.text: Social dynamics encode the process in which individual network and discourse interactions aggregate into collective influence, narrative dominance and coordinate behavior. This paper uses the the GhostField architecture, a hybrid LLM-Enabled Agent Based Network-Dynamic (LAND) model as a social simulation framework to build the AuraSight scenario. In the AuraSight scenario, 314,244 heterogeneous cyber social agents and human actors exchange 529,327 messages over 30 days surrounding a fictional international song-writing contest. We methodologically examine emergent social dynamics across four analytical layers: ego-network topology, semantic network evolution, coordination dynamics and influence dynamics. Our results show how generated social simulations do also produce social dynamics, and how the dynamics of coordination and influence emerge not from individual agents but from the recursive interaction between network topology and narrative exchange.
efb22fe9c378a71c.abstract_zh: 社会动态描述个体层面的网络互动和话语互动如何聚合成集体影响力、叙事主导和协同行为。这篇论文用 GhostField 架构，一个混合的 LLM 驱动智能体网络动态模型（LAND），作为社会仿真框架，搭建了 AuraSight 场景。该场景围绕一场虚构的国际歌曲创作大赛展开，314,244 个异构的网络社交智能体与真人参与者在 30 天里交换了 529,327 条消息。作者从四个分析层面考察涌现出的社会动态：自我网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协调动态和影响力动态。结果显示，生成式社会仿真确实能产生社会动态，而且协调与影响力的动态不是由单个智能体产生，而是来自网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归互动。材料未报告与真实数据的对比验证，局限与展望也未提及。
efb22fe9c378a71c.why: 它展示了一个可复用的混合 LLM 智能体网络动态框架，并在 30 万量级智能体、50 万条消息的规模上考察协调与影响力如何从网络结构与叙事的递归互动中涌现，对做大规模舆论与协同行为仿真的研究者有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 推演大规模社交网络中个体互动如何聚合成集体影响力、叙事主导和协同行为的社会动态过程。
brief.setup: 使用 GhostField 架构（LLM 驱动的智能体网络动态混合模型 LAND），构建虚构的国际歌曲创作比赛场景 AuraSight。314,244 个异构网络社交智能体与人类参与者，在 30 天内交换 529,327 条消息。
brief.method: 从四个分析层检验涌现的社会动态：自我网络拓扑、语义网络演化、协同动态和影响力动态。
brief.findings: 生成的社会仿真确实产生了社会动态；协同与影响力的动态不是来自单个智能体，而是来自网络拓扑与叙事交换之间的递归交互。

eefea71d749df811.text: There is growing interest in using large language models (LLMs) as low-cost proxies for resident attitudes in urban planning. Previous work shows that LLMs can predict average results of survey experiments, but less is known about whether they preserve the spatially anchored, identity-conditioned structure behind those averages, namely how support changes as a project approaches homes and how that response divides across tenure and partisan groups. We compared eight open-weight LLMs with 843 respondents in a US affordable-housing survey experiment, testing whether they reproduced the owner-renter difference in support change as a proposed development moved from 2 miles to 1/8 mile. Qwen 2.5 14B was closest (-0.242 versus the human -0.285) and was the only model to meet the prespecified +/-0.20 equivalence criterion; Phi-4 14B was directionally aligned but attenuated (-0.150), and other models showed weak, null, or reversed moderation. This aggregate match masked structural failure. Qwen attenuated the Republican contrast and exaggerated the Independent one, its RMSE across 27 party-by-tenure-by-item cells was 0.613, its median model-to-human variance ratio was 0.099, and question order shifted the contrast by +0.367. Identity-cue removal and selective nonresponse changed which comparisons were estimable, and rationale-first responses differed from matched direct-choice responses in 20.6-35.3% of focal comparisons. An LLM can thus approximate one aggregate contrast while failing to preserve the population structure, within-group heterogeneity, and measurement stability that generate it. Model evaluation in urban planning should test whether this spatial and social structure survives simulation, not only average effects.
eefea71d749df811.abstract_zh: 背景是城市规划界越来越想把大模型当作居民态度的低成本替代品。已有工作表明大模型能预测调查实验的平均结果，但没人检验过这些平均值背后依赖空间和身份的结构，也就是支持度如何随项目逼近住宅而变化，以及这种变化在房主与租客、不同党派群体之间如何分化。作者把八个开源权重模型和 843 名美国保障房调查实验的受访者做对比，测试模型能否复现当拟建开发项目从 2 英里移到 1/8 英里时，房主与租客支持度变化幅度的差异。结果上，Qwen 2.5 14B 最接近人类（-0.242 对 -0.285），也是唯一满足预设 ±0.20 等效标准的模型；Phi-4 14B 方向一致但被削弱（-0.150）；其余模型出现弱、零或反向的调节效应。总体匹配掩盖了结构性失败。Qwen 削弱了共和党群体的对比、夸大了无党派群体的对比，在 27 个党派×产权×题项单元上 RMSE 为 0.613，模型与人类方差比中位数为 0.099，问题顺序变化使对比偏移 +0.367。去掉身份线索和选择性不回答会改变哪些比较可估计，先给理由再作答的回答与匹配的直接选择在 20.6% 到 35.3% 的关键比较中不一致。作者由此指出，大模型可以在逼近一个总体对比的同时，丢失产生它的人口结构、组内异质性和测量稳定性。城市规划中的模型评估应该检验空间与社会结构能否在仿真中存活，而不只看平均效应。
eefea71d749df811.why: 它给用大模型模拟居民态度的仿真研究者提供了一个具体反例：总体效应对上了不等于群体结构对上了，并附带了可直接复用的等效检验流程和分单元误差指标。

brief.question: LLM 能否作为低成本代理来代表城市居民对规划项目的态度，即能否在复现平均实验结果之外，保留随空间距离和身份群体（产权、党派）变化的支持度结构。
brief.setup: 8 个开源权重 LLM 与 843 名美国可负担住房调查实验的受访者对比。实验情境是拟建开发项目从 2 英里移近到 1/8 英里时支持度的变化，按业主/租客和党派分组比较。
brief.method: 测试各模型能否复现业主-租客群体在项目逼近时支持度变化的差异，设定了 +/-0.20 的等效性标准；进一步做了身份线索移除、选择性无应答、先给理由再作答与直接作答的对比，以及问题顺序敏感性检验。
brief.findings: Qwen 2.5 14B 最接近人类（-0.242 对 -0.285），是唯一满足 +/-0.20 等效标准的模型；Phi-4 14B 方向一致但被衰减（-0.150），其余模型出现弱、零或反向的调节效应。但 Qwen 的总体匹配掩盖了结构性失败：削弱了共和党群体的对比、夸大了独立人士的对比，27 个党派×产权×题项单元格的 RMSE 为 0.613，模型与人类方差比中位数为 0.099，问题顺序使对比偏移 +0.367。先给理由的回答与直接选择在 20.6-35.3% 的焦点比较中不一致。
brief.validation: 与 843 名真实受访者的调查实验数据对比，含预设等效性标准、27 个分组单元格的 RMSE、方差比、问题顺序和应答方式的敏感性检验，验证强度较高。
brief.limits: 模型能近似一个总体对比，却无法保留产生该对比的人群结构、组内异质性和测量稳定性；身份线索移除和选择性无应答会改变哪些比较可估计。

eb2b70293a48b1d2.text: This paper addresses key technical challenges in current large language model (LLM) agent applications, including long-horizon planning, sparse reward attribution, and dynamic environmental interaction, by designing and optimizing an intelligent agent workflow. The proposed architecture is based on the synthesis of core AI paradigms: Visual, Language, Generative, Graph, Multimodal, Reinforcement, and Agent Intelligence. Unlike conventional baseline models that rely on static prompting and lack robust perception-action loops, our approach introduces a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) routing mechanism. This mechanism is augmented with an internal, self-correcting reward model that evaluates decision trajectories before execution. By integrating multimodal inputs and advanced reinforcement learning principles (such as proximal policy optimization and value function approximation), the agent maintains long-term structural memory and dynamically adapts its reasoning pathways to mitigate error accumulation. Empirical experiments on the ALFWorld embodied simulation environment and the WebShop online navigation benchmark demonstrate a 24.5% absolute improvement in task success rate and trajectory efficiency over mainstream baselines like the standard ReAct framework. Comprehensive ablation studies confirm the significant contribution of the reward-driven critique module in suppressing hallucination rates. This research bridges theoretical foundations of reinforcement learning and graph-based memory with autonomous agent workflows. Ultimately, the resulting architecture offers a practical, scalable reference framework for developing artificial intelligence technologies in complex, multi-step autonomous systems. Code is available at https://github.com/01Amez/RLAW_Implementation.

e134df5d6c9df5fb.text: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used to simulate socially complex and interaction-driven tasks. However, most existing studies rely on hand-crafted personas. Since persona design strongly shapes how agents interpret context and make decisions, developing empirically grounded agent profiles is a significant aspect in this underexplored research area. To address this limitation, we propose a survey-grounded generative agent-based modeling (GABM) simulation framework that translates real survey respondents into generative LLM agents. The main objective of our framework is to demonstrate how careful persona design enables realistic simulation of decision-making using LLMs for facilitating behavioral experiments. We illustrate the framework's applicability through a case study of mobility policy preference dynamics in Germany, focusing on public support for phasing out new internal combustion engine vehicles, which is part of the European Union's net-zero target. Our benchmark is based on 514 survey respondents, each translated into a natural-language persona, grounded in demographic characteristics, political orientation, mobility behavior, fuel experience, and climate-related attitudes. The simulation goal is to examine how support evolves over time, how agents switch positions across rounds, and how responses differ across survey-grounded personas under changing social and policy contexts.
e134df5d6c9df5fb.abstract_zh:
现有用大语言模型做社会仿真的研究大多依赖手工构造的画像，而画像设计会直接影响智能体如何理解情境和做决策，所以基于经验数据构建智能体档案是这块研究里还没被充分探索的问题。作者提出一个基于调查的生成式智能体建模（GABM）仿真框架，把真实问卷受访者翻译成生成式 LLM 智能体，目标是说明精细的画像设计能让 LLM 仿真出更真实的决策行为，从而支持行为实验。

案例研究做的是德国出行政策偏好动态，聚焦公众对淘汰新燃油车（欧盟净零目标的一部分）的支持度。基准数据来自 514 名受访者，每个人都被翻译成一个自然语言画像，画像里包含人口统计特征、政治倾向、出行行为、加油体验和气候相关态度。仿真要考察三件事：支持度如何随时间演化、智能体如何在多轮之间切换立场、以及在不同社会和政策情境下，基于调查的画像之间响应有何差异。
e134df5d6c9df5fb.why: 它给出了一个把真实问卷数据转成 LLM 智能体画像的可复用做法，对想做政策偏好推演或行为实验的人是直接的方法参考，也回应了手工画像不可靠这个常见痛点。

brief.question: 推演德国出行政策偏好动态：公众对淘汰新燃油车（欧盟净零目标的一部分）的支持度如何随时间演变、智能体立场如何跨轮次切换。
brief.setup: 514 名真实调查受访者被转成自然语言 persona，包含人口特征、政治倾向、出行行为、燃油使用经历和气候态度；使用 LLM 生成式智能体，在变化的社会与政策情境下多轮仿真。具体模型和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 提出 survey-grounded generative agent-based modeling（GABM）框架，把真实调查受访者翻译成有实证依据的 persona，替代手工编写的 persona，再让 LLM 智能体在情境变化中做决策。
brief.findings: 未说明（摘要未给出具体结果数字）。
brief.validation: 未说明（摘要提到 benchmark 基于 514 名受访者，但未描述与真实数据对比的方式和强度）。
brief.reuse: GABM 框架：将调查数据转为 LLM persona 的方法，可用于行为实验仿真；具体代码和数据是否公开未说明。

e330d7ac8c0ab8d0.text: Interactive traffic simulation is a vital world model for autonomous driving. A central challenge in long-horizon simulation is modeling sustained multi-agent interactions, which is further exacerbated by dynamic token cardinality as agents continuously enter and exit the scene. In this work, we propose that the solution lies in the synergy between the architectural inductive biases and statistical priors of large-scale sequence models, e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs). Our probing experiments reveal that the transferability of attention mechanisms and the distributional consistency between motion tokens and natural language enable small-scale, heavily frozen LLMs to rapidly adapt to traffic modeling. Building on this insight, we introduce RosettaSim, a unified framework that projects scene topology, agent states, and spawning intents into a structured autoregressive stream with variable length, achieving both strong short-term accuracy and stable long-horizon simulation fidelity. Furthermore, evaluating extended rollouts presents yet another hurdle, as one-to-one agent correspondence inevitably fades over time. To address this, we introduce Retrieval-based Traffic Evaluation (RTE), which retrieves semantically similar real-world scenarios as context-aware reference anchors. Experiments on the Waymo Open Sim Agent Challenge (WOSAC) demonstrate that RosettaSim achieves state-of-the-art performance in both short- and long-term simulation. Furthermore, RTE exhibits a stronger correlation with standard metrics ($r=0.83$) than existing approaches ($r=0.74$), indicating improved alignment with long-horizon simulation fidelity.
e330d7ac8c0ab8d0.abstract_zh: 交互式交通仿真是自动驾驶的重要世界模型，长时程仿真的核心难点在于持续的多智能体交互建模，而且智能体不断进出场景，token 数量动态变化，问题更棘手。作者先做探针实验，发现注意力机制可迁移，且运动 token 与自然语言的分布一致性，让小规模、大部分参数冻结的 LLM 能快速适配交通建模。基于这个发现，他们提出 RosettaSim，把场景拓扑、智能体状态和生成意图投影成变长的结构化自回归流，兼顾短期精度和长时程仿真保真度。评估长时程仿真还有另一个难题：随着时间推移，仿真智能体与真实智能体的一一对应关系会消失。为此作者提出检索式交通评估（RTE），检索语义相似的真实场景作为上下文相关的参考锚点。在 Waymo Open Sim Agent Challenge（WOSAC）上，RosettaSim 在短期和长期仿真上都达到最优；RTE 与标准指标的相关性为 0.83，高于现有方法的 0.74，说明它更贴近长时程仿真保真度。局限方面材料未展开讨论。
e330d7ac8c0ab8d0.why: 它给出了一条复用 LLM 架构先验做交通世界模型的可行路线，RTE 还提供了长时程仿真评估的新方法，对做仿真环境与评测的人都可参考。

brief.question: 长时程交通仿真中如何建模持续的多智能体交互，以及智能体不断进出场景导致的动态 token 数量变化问题；同时解决长时程仿真结果难以评估的问题。
brief.setup: 使用大规模冻结的 LLM 作为骨干，把场景拓扑、智能体状态和生成意图投影成变长的结构化自回归 token 流，在 Waymo Open Sim Agent Challenge (WOSAC) 数据上做交互式交通仿真。智能体数量与时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: RosettaSim 框架：利用注意力机制的可迁移性和运动 token 与自然语言的分布一致性，让小规模、大部分参数冻结的 LLM 快速适配交通建模；并提出 Retrieval-based Traffic Evaluation (RTE)，检索语义相似的真实场景作为上下文参考锚点来评估长时程仿真。
brief.findings: RosettaSim 在 WOSAC 上取得短时程和长时程仿真的 state-of-the-art 表现；RTE 与标准指标的相关系数 r=0.83，高于现有方法的 r=0.74。探针实验显示冻结 LLM 能快速适应交通建模。
brief.validation: 在 Waymo Open Sim Agent Challenge (WOSAC) 上与现有方法对比，RTE 通过与标准指标的相关性（0.83 vs 0.74）验证其与长时程仿真保真度的对齐程度；未说明与真实轨迹的误差数值。
brief.reuse: RosettaSim 框架和 RTE 评估方法；利用冻结 LLM 的架构归纳偏置与统计先验适配运动 token 的做法。代码是否开源未说明。

e6da69621c685031.text: People make decisions differently in strategic interactions. Some update beliefs like a Bayesian; others exhibit biases like motivated reasoning. Although creators of large language models use simulated humans for safety evaluations and training, they often fail to cover this breadth of human behavior. We argue that cognitive science and economics provide a convenient tool for doing so, making use of mathematical models of human decision-making. We propose an approach that we call Equation-to-Behavior Prompting for guiding large language models to match cognitive models, and evaluate this approach on persuasion games based on legal decision-making. We find that large models can approximate equation-based specifications -- Bayesian updating, affine distortion, motivated updating, and Grether's $α$-$β$ model -- using prompting, but small models fail to do so. However, training small models with reinforcement learning to adhere to mathematical rules, Equation-to-Behavior RL, reduces belief error by 26.5% in out-of-distribution parameterizations. We show that these simulations can help create diverse training environments; training small models to consider different kinds of decision-makers improves average belief change by 2.5%--12% over Bayesian-only training, even when persuading GPT-5-mini. Our work could improve human simulations for training and evaluation in increasingly realistic settings, and could also enable novel research into more complicated mathematical models of human decision-making.
e6da69621c685031.abstract_zh:
人在策略互动中的决策方式各不相同：有人像贝叶斯那样更新信念，有人表现出动机性推理等偏差。大模型的开发者常用模拟人类做安全评估和训练，但这些模拟往往覆盖不了人类行为的这种多样性。作者提出，认知科学与经济学里的数学化人类决策模型可以补上这块缺口。

做法上，作者提出 Equation-to-Behavior Prompting，用提示引导大语言模型去匹配具体的认知模型方程，并在基于法律决策的说服博弈上做评测。这些方程包括贝叶斯更新、仿射扭曲、动机性更新和 Grether 的 α-β 模型。结果显示，大模型可以靠提示近似这些方程刻画的决策规则，小模型做不到。于是作者进一步提出 Equation-to-Behavior RL，用强化学习训练小模型遵守数学规则，在分布外参数化下把信念误差降低了 26.5%。

这些模拟可以用来构造多样的训练环境。让小模型在训练中面对不同类型的决策者，相比只用贝叶斯决策者训练，平均信念改变提升 2.5% 到 12%，即使对手换成 GPT-5-mini 也成立。作者认为这项工作能改进更真实场景下用于训练和评估的人类模拟，也可能支持对更复杂的人类决策数学模型的研究。
e6da69621c685031.why: 它给“如何让 LLM 模拟的人类行为有认知科学依据”提供了一条可操作的路径，且给出了小模型靠 RL 对齐数学规则、分布外仍有效的量化证据，对构建仿真训练环境的人直接可用。

e4b77e3a36fbc8ee.text: LLM-based multi-agent simulation offers a promising way to study social interaction, deliberation, and collective opinion dynamics. However, many existing dialogue simulation frameworks represent interaction mainly as observable turn exchange or aggregated outputs, leaving the internal evaluative processes behind silence, speaking intention, and public expression difficult to examine. We introduce TBS (Think-Before-Speak), an interval-based multi-agent simulation framework that separates agents' private reasoning from public utterance generation. At each interval, all agents update structured internal states based on the shared dialogue history and their own memory. These states include dissonance-related appraisal, perceived opinion climate, perceived isolation risk, response strategy, and willingness to speak. The orchestrator then resolves competing speaking intentions and commits one utterance to the public dialogue, allowing internal evaluation and public interaction to co-evolve over time. We evaluate TBS in simulated town hall discussions on a climate-related policy issue. Results show that TBS produces coherent internal-state traces and that these traces vary systematically across turn-allocation, silence, and memory conditions. Dissonance-related appraisal increases agents' willingness to speak, whereas silence-pressure appraisal decreases it. Once speaking intention is formed, public expression is shaped mainly by turn-allocation rules. These findings suggest that TBS supports mechanism-sensitive social simulation by making the pathway from internal evaluation to public expression observable and analyzable.
e4b77e3a36fbc8ee.abstract_zh: 现有基于大模型的多智能体对话仿真大多把互动表示成可观察的轮次交换或聚合输出，智能体在沉默、发言意图和公开表达背后的内部评估过程难以考察。作者为此提出 TBS（Think-Before-Speak），一个基于间隔的多智能体仿真框架，把智能体的私下推理和公开话语生成分开。每个间隔中，所有智能体基于共享对话历史和自身记忆更新结构化内部状态，包括与认知失调相关的评估、感知的意见气候、感知的孤立风险、回应策略和发言意愿。随后由协调器裁决相互竞争的发言意图，只提交一条话语进入公开对话，让内部评估和公开互动随时间共同演化。作者在围绕气候相关政策的模拟市政厅讨论中评测 TBS。结果显示 TBS 产生连贯的内部状态轨迹，这些轨迹在轮次分配、沉默和记忆条件之间有系统性差异：失调相关评估提高智能体的发言意愿，沉默压力评估降低发言意愿；发言意图一旦形成，公开表达主要受轮次分配规则影响。作者认为 TBS 让从内部评估到公开表达的路径变得可观察、可分析，支持对机制敏感的社会仿真。材料未报告与真实数据的对比验证。
e4b77e3a36fbc8ee.why: 它把智能体的沉默、发言意愿这类通常被隐藏的内部评估显式建模成结构化状态，并给出失调评估与发言意愿之间的可检验关系，对研究舆论形成和群体讨论机制的人是可复用的框架设计。

e46f455c3d8fc8e2.text: Herding -- where agents align their behaviors and act collectively -- is a central driver of market fragility and systemic risk. Existing approaches to quantify herding rely on price-correlation statistics, which inherently lag because they only detect coordination after it has already moved realised returns. We propose GeomHerd, a forward-looking geometric framework that bypasses this observability lag by quantifying coordination directly on upstream agent-interaction graphs. To generate these graphs, we treat a heterogeneous LLM-driven multi-agent simulator -- each financial trader instantiated by a persona-conditioned LLM call -- as a forecastable world, and evaluate the geometric pipeline on the Cividino--Sornette continuous-spin agent-based substrate as our headline financial testbed. By tracking the discrete Ollivier--Ricci curvature of these action graphs, GeomHerd captures the structural topology of emerging coordination. Theoretically, we establish a mean-field bridge mapping our graph-theoretic metric to CSAD, the classical macroscopic herding statistic, linking GeomHerd to downstream price-dispersion measurement. Empirically, GeomHerd anticipates herding long before aggregate market baselines: on the continuous-spin substrate, our primary detector fires a median of 272 steps before order-parameter onset; a contagion detector ($β_{-}$) recalls 65% of critical trajectories 318 steps early; and on co-firing trajectories the agent-graph signal precedes price-correlation-graph baselines by 40 steps. As a complementary indicator, the effective vocabulary of agent actions contracts during cascades. The geometric signature transfers out-of-domain to the Vicsek self-driven-particle model, and a curvature-conditioned forecasting head reduces cascade-window log-return MAE over detector-conditioned and price-only baselines.
e46f455c3d8fc8e2.abstract_zh:
羊群行为指智能体行为趋同、集体行动，是市场脆弱性和系统性风险的核心驱动因素。现有量化方法依赖价格相关性统计，只能在协同已经推动实际收益之后才检测到它，存在天然的滞后。作者提出 GeomHerd，一个前瞻性的几何框架，直接在上游的智能体交互图上量化协同，绕开这一可观测性滞后。

做法上，作者把一个异质 LLM 多智能体模拟器当作可预测的世界，每个金融交易者由一次带人设条件的 LLM 调用实例化，并在 Cividino-Sornette 连续自旋基底这一金融测试床上评估几何流水线。通过追踪行为图的离散 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，GeomHerd 捕捉正在形成的协同的结构拓扑。理论上，作者建立了均场桥梁，把这一图论度量映射到经典宏观羊群统计量 CSAD，将其与下游价格离散度测量联系起来。

实证结果方面，GeomHerd 远早于聚合市场基线预警羊群行为：在连续自旋基底上，主检测器比序参量出现早中位数 272 步；传染检测器（β₋）提前 318 步召回 65% 的临界轨迹；在共同触发的轨迹上，智能体图信号比价格相关性图基线早 40 步。作为补充指标，级联期间智能体行为的有效词汇量收缩。几何信号还能跨域迁移到 Vicsek 自驱动粒子模型，且一个以曲率为条件的预测头在级联窗口的对数收益 MAE 上优于检测器条件基线和仅价格基线。
e46f455c3d8fc8e2.why: 它给做市场仿真的研究者提供了一个可复用的前瞻性风险指标：在 LLM 多智能体模拟器的交互图上算 Ricci 曲率，就能比价格类统计早数百步发现协同形成，并有到 CSAD 的理论桥接和跨模型迁移实验支撑。

e62663c24c5cbe47.text: Conversational recommender systems (CRSs) are a core component of next-generation intelligent recommender systems because they enable users to actively elicit preferences, clarify intentions, and adapt recommendations in real time. However, there are two key obstacles in the CRS domain: evaluation and access to training data. Evaluating CRSs through real human studies is more critical than for traditional recommender systems, yet such studies are both costly and time-consuming. Moreover, CRS interaction data are often difficult to obtain for model training due to privacy concerns. Large language model (LLM)-based user simulators have shown promise in addressing both challenges by generating synthetic user interactions for evaluation and training. However, existing approaches suffer from systematic positive bias, data leakage, and limited behavioral diversity, and they rely on brittle manual prompt engineering that requires extensive domain expertise. In this paper, we propose a framework to automatically optimize prompts for LLM-based user simulators in CRSs, simultaneously mitigating these issues. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves improved behavioral alignment with human interaction patterns compared to baseline methods across diverse prompt settings.

ed0cddb711ad36d3.text: Conversational recommender systems (CRS) increasingly rely on user simulators for automated evaluation of sales agents. A key requirement for such simulators is the ability to model human decision-making. However, most existing simulation frameworks do not explicitly model the internal decision process, and LLM-based simulators often exhibit unrealistically strong information-processing capabilities, rarely exhibit the hesitation or decision deferral commonly observed in real consumer behavior, resulting in overly high acceptance probabilities. To address this limitation, we propose Hesitator, a theory-grounded user simulation framework that explicitly models human decision-making under choice overload. The framework introduces a modular Decision Module that separates utility-based item selection from overload-aware commitment decisions. Experiments across multiple user simulation frameworks, domains, sales modes, and LLM backbones show that integrating our module consistently mitigates unrealistic behaviors under increasing overload conditions. Furthermore, Hesitator reproduces established behavioral patterns from psychological economics, demonstrating its ability to model human decision behavior.

e90a112adb83b530.text: The expression of emotions that serve social purposes, such as asserting independence or fostering interdependence, is central to human interactions and varies systematically across cultures. As LLMs are increasingly used to simulate human behavior in culturally nuanced interactions, it is important to understand whether they faithfully capture human patterns of social emotion expression. When LLM responses are not culturally aligned, their utility is compromised -- particularly when users assume they are interacting with a culturally attuned interlocutor, and may act on advice that proves inappropriate in their cultural context. We present a psychologically informed evaluation framework of cross-cultural social emotion expression in LLMs. Using a human study comparing European American and Latin American participants' expression of engaging and disengaging emotions, we evaluate six frontier LLMs on their ability to reflect culturally differentiated patterns for expressing social emotions. We find systematic misalignment between model and human behavior: all models express engaging emotions more than disengaging ones, with particularly stark differences observed for the generally well-represented European American persona. We further highlight that LLM responses are highly concentrated and deterministic, failing to capture the diversity of human responses in expressing social emotions. Our ablation analyses reveal that these patterns are robust to sampling temperatures, partially sensitive to prompt language, and dependent on the response elicitation format. Together, our findings highlight limitations in how current LLMs represent the interaction of cultural and emotional axes, particularly when expressing social emotions, with direct implications for their deployment in cross-cultural affective contexts.

ed53d8c8968d1fb3.text: The increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in everyday life brings with it new challenges and questions for regarding how humans interact with autonomous agents. Multi-agent experiments, where humans and AI act together, can offer important opportunities to study social decision making, but there is a lack of accessible tooling available to researchers to run such experiments. We introduce two tools designed to reduce these barriers. The first, CoGrid, is a multi-agent grid-based simulation library with dual NumPy and JAX backends. The second, Multi-User Gymnasium (MUG), translates such simulation environments directly into interactive web-based experiments. MUG supports interactions with arbitrary numbers of humans and AI, utilizing either server-authoritative or peer-to-peer networking with rollback netcode to account for latency. Together, these tools can enable researchers to deploy studies of human-AI interaction, facilitating inquiry into core questions of psychology, cognition, and decision making and their relationship to human-AI interaction. Both tools are open source and available to the broader research community. Documentation and source code is available at {cogrid, multi-user-gymnasium}.readthedocs.io. This paper details the functionality of these tools and presents several case studies to illustrate their utility in human-AI multi-agent experimentation.

e6d8754cb18decc6.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for generating complex behaviors, yet most approaches lack mechanisms for modeling social motivation in human-like multi-agent interaction. We introduce Autonomous Social Value-Oriented agents (ASVO), where LLM-based agents integrate desire-driven autonomy with Social Value Orientation (SVO) theory. At each step, agents first update their beliefs by perceiving environmental changes and others' actions. These observations inform the value update process, where each agent updates multi-dimensional desire values through reflective reasoning and infers others' motivational states. By contrasting self-satisfaction derived from fulfilled desires against estimated others' satisfaction, agents dynamically compute their SVO along a spectrum from altruistic to competitive, which in turn guides activity selection to balance desire fulfillment with social alignment. Experiments across School, Workplace, and Family contexts demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines in behavioral naturalness and human-likeness. These findings show that structured desire systems and adaptive SVO drift enable realistic multi-agent social simulations.

e22ac3a7500996b6.text: People's transportation choices reflect complex trade-offs shaped by personal preferences, social norms, and technology acceptance. Predicting such behavior at scale is a critical challenge with major implications for urban planning and sustainable transport. Traditional methods use handcrafted assumptions and costly data collection, making them impractical for early-stage evaluations of new technologies or policies. We introduce Generative Traffic Agents (GTA) for simulating large-scale, context-sensitive transportation choices using LLM-powered, persona-based agents. GTA generates artificial populations from census-based sociodemographic data. It simulates activity schedules and mode choices, enabling scalable, human-like simulations without handcrafted rules. We evaluate GTA in Berlin-scale experiments, comparing simulation results against empirical data. While agents replicate patterns, such as modal split by socioeconomic status, they show systematic biases in trip length and mode preference. GTA offers new opportunities for modeling how future innovations, from bike lanes to transit apps, shape mobility decisions.
e22ac3a7500996b6.abstract_zh: 人们的交通选择反映了个人偏好、社会规范和技术接受度共同塑造的复杂权衡，大规模预测这类行为对城市规划和可持续交通很关键。传统方法依赖手工设定的假设和昂贵的数据采集，难以用于新技术或新政策的早期评估。作者提出 GTA，用基于 LLM 的人格智能体做大规模、情境敏感的交通选择仿真。GTA 从基于人口普查的社会人口数据生成人工人口，模拟活动日程和交通方式选择，不需要手工规则就能做可扩展的类人仿真。评估在柏林规模上进行，仿真结果与实证数据对比。智能体复现了一些模式，比如按社会经济地位划分的交通方式分担率，但在出行距离和方式偏好上表现出系统性偏差。作者认为 GTA 为建模未来创新（从自行车道到公交 App）如何影响出行决策提供了新途径。局限在于上述系统性偏差尚未解决。
e22ac3a7500996b6.why: 它展示了 LLM 智能体仿真可以替代传统四阶段模型做早期政策评估，同时诚实报告了出行距离和方式偏好上的系统性偏差，对做城市仿真的人是可复用的方法和已知风险清单。

brief.question: 预测大规模人群的出行选择行为，用于评估新交通技术或政策（如自行车道、公交应用）对出行决策的影响，替代依赖手工假设和昂贵数据采集的传统方法。
brief.setup: 基于 LLM 的 persona 智能体，从基于人口普查的社会人口数据生成人工人口，在柏林规模上仿真活动日程和出行方式选择。智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 用 LLM 驱动的 persona 智能体生成人工人口，仿真活动日程（activity schedules）和方式选择（mode choices），无需手工规则。
brief.findings: 智能体能复现部分真实模式，例如按社会经济地位划分的交通方式分担（modal split），但在出行距离和方式偏好上存在系统性偏差。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 在柏林规模的实验中与实证数据（empirical data）对比仿真结果，发现部分模式可复现、部分存在系统偏差，属于与真实数据的直接对比，但未给出误差数字。
brief.limits: 智能体在出行距离（trip length）和方式偏好上存在系统性偏差。
brief.reuse: 从人口普查数据生成 persona 人工人口并用 LLM 仿真活动日程与方式选择的方法流程可借鉴，代码和数据是否公开未说明。

ee0c7cde2128367e.text: Field experiments (A/B tests) are often the most credible benchmark for methods (algorithms) in societal systems, but their cost and latency bottleneck rapid methodological progress. LLM-based persona simulation offers a cheap synthetic alternative, yet it is unclear whether replacing humans with personas preserves the benchmark interface that adaptive methods optimize against. We prove an if-and-only-if characterization: when (i) methods observe only the aggregate outcome (aggregate-only observation) and (ii) evaluation depends only on the submitted artifact and not on the method's identity or provenance (method-blind evaluation), swapping humans for personas is just panel change from the method's point of view, indistinguishable from changing the evaluation population (e.g., New York to Jakarta). Furthermore, we move from validity to usefulness: we define an information-theoretic discriminability of the induced aggregate channel and show that making persona benchmarking as decision-relevant as a field experiment is fundamentally a sample-size question, yielding explicit bounds on the number of independent persona evaluations required to reliably distinguish meaningfully different methods at a chosen resolution.

efbb2260ef22d9fc.text: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly advances, especially in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), research focus is shifting from single-modality text processing to the more complex domains of multimodal and embodied AI. Embodied intelligence focuses on training agents within realistic simulated environments, leveraging physical interaction and action feedback rather than conventionally labeled datasets. Yet, most existing simulation platforms remain narrowly designed, each tailored to specific tasks. A versatile, general-purpose training environment that can support everything from low-level embodied navigation to high-level composite activities, such as multi-agent social simulation and human-AI collaboration, remains largely unavailable. To bridge this gap, we introduce TongSIM, a high-fidelity, general-purpose platform for training and evaluating embodied agents. TongSIM offers practical advantages by providing over 100 diverse, multi-room indoor scenarios as well as an open-ended, interaction-rich outdoor town simulation, ensuring broad applicability across research needs. Its comprehensive evaluation framework and benchmarks enable precise assessment of agent capabilities, such as perception, cognition, decision-making, human-robot cooperation, and spatial and social reasoning. With features like customized scenes, task-adaptive fidelity, diverse agent types, and dynamic environmental simulation, TongSIM delivers flexibility and scalability for researchers, serving as a unified platform that accelerates training, evaluation, and advancement toward general embodied intelligence.

e6e86884a268a404.text: Multi-agent role-playing has recently shown promise for studying social behavior with language agents, but existing simulations are mostly monolingual without cross-lingual interaction, an essential property of real societies. We introduce MAWM, the first Multilingual Agent-based World Modeling framework that supports multi-turn multilingual interactions among generative agents with diverse sociolinguistic profiles. MAWM enables two modes of analysis: (i) global public opinion modeling, which tracks how attitudes toward open-domain survey questions evolve across languages and cultures, and (ii) media influence and information diffusion, via autonomous news agents that dynamically generate content and shape user behavior. To ground the simulation in realistic population distributions, we construct the MAPS benchmark, which combines survey questions and demographic personas drawn from global population distributions. Experiments on simulation alignment, along with social science case studies on cultural assimilation and normative diffusion, show that native-language simulation better reflects real survey data than English-only simulation, and that the agent society in MAWM reproduces established sociocultural phenomena and highlights the value of multilingual simulation as an alternative interpretable tool for computational social science.
e6e86884a268a404.abstract_zh: 现有多智能体角色扮演仿真大多是单语的，缺少真实社会中普遍存在的跨语言交互。作者提出 MAWM，据称是首个多语言智能体世界建模框架，支持具有不同社会语言学画像的生成式智能体之间进行多轮多语言交互。框架提供两种分析模式：一是全球舆论建模，追踪对开放域调查问题的态度如何跨语言、跨文化演化；二是媒体影响与信息扩散，通过自主生成内容的新闻智能体来影响用户行为。为了让仿真贴近真实人口分布，作者构建了 MAPS 基准，组合了来自全球人口分布的人口画像与调查问题。在仿真对齐实验以及文化同化、规范扩散两个社会科学案例研究中，母语仿真比纯英语仿真更好地反映真实调查数据，MAWM 中的智能体社会也复现了已知的社会文化现象。作者认为多语言仿真可以作为计算社会科学的一种可解释的替代工具。材料未提供具体误差数字或实验规模。
e6e86884a268a404.why: 它把“仿真语言”本身当成变量，给出母语仿真优于英语仿真的证据，对做舆论、文化演化仿真的研究者是可直接借鉴的框架和基准。

brief.question: 现有语言智能体社会仿真基本是单语的，缺少真实社会中跨语言互动这一属性。MAWM 想推演多语言社会中的全球舆论演化，以及媒体对信息扩散的影响。
brief.setup: MAWM 是多智能体角色扮演框架，智能体带有不同社会语言学画像，支持多轮多语言互动。配套构建了 MAPS 基准，把调查问题与来自全球人口分布的人口画像结合。具体智能体数量、环境规模、时间尺度和使用的底层模型均未说明。
brief.method: 两种分析模式：一是全球舆论建模，追踪对开放域调查问题的态度如何跨语言跨文化演化；二是媒体影响与信息扩散，由自主新闻智能体动态生成内容并影响用户行为。
brief.findings: 母语仿真比纯英语仿真更贴近真实调查数据；MAWM 的智能体社会复现了已知的社会文化现象。作者在文化同化和规范扩散上做了社会科学案例研究。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与真实调查数据对齐做仿真对齐实验，比较母语仿真与纯英语仿真贴合真实调查的程度，并复现已确立的社会文化现象作为检验。误差等具体指标未说明。
brief.reuse: MAWM 框架和 MAPS 基准（含全球人口分布的调查问题与人口画像）可直接用于多语言社会仿真研究。代码是否开源未说明。

ed70c95f4f57fc19.text: We develop a transparent, auditable large language model (LLM) pipeline for macro-financial stress testing. Structured prompting, with optional retrieval of country fundamentals and news, emits G7 macroeconomic scenarios (GDP growth, inflation, policy rate), which are converted into deviations from an IMF World Economic Outlook baseline and translated into portfolio losses through a three-channel PCA factor model. The macro-to-factor mapping is stipulated rather than estimated, so every tail-risk multiple is conditional on stated assumptions. Across 2,420 accepted scenarios from two model families and three runs, plus an unanchored-severity run and eight risk-layer ablations, we find three things. First, severity is inherited from scenario design, not generated by the model: prompt variant dominates every variance decomposition, removing the prompted severity bands makes GPT-5.6-luna's recession 1.6 pp milder, apparent country heterogeneity largely reflects the institutional baseline, and retrieval and news matter only where the prompt leaves magnitude free. Second, numerical severity and narrative severity are only weakly coupled. Third, GPT-5.6-luna follows its own arithmetic but anchors on prompted bands, whereas Llama-3.1-8B is four to seven times more dispersed and contradicts its own stated changes in 90% of cases. A repeat run differs at the scenario level yet agrees on aggregate multiples to within 0.007 times. LLM scenario generators are best used for narrative and sector elicitation around a prescribed severity path, not as autonomous calibrators of stress magnitude.

ef1fba0c494d4d22.text: Online Social Networks (OSNs) widely adopt content moderation to mitigate the spread of abusive and toxic discourse. Nonetheless, the real effectiveness of moderation interventions remains unclear due to the high cost of data collection and limited experimental control. The latest developments in Natural Language Processing pave the way for a new evaluation approach. Large Language Models (LLMs) can be successfully leveraged to enhance Agent-Based Modeling and simulate human-like social behavior with unprecedented degree of believability. Yet, existing tools do not support simulation-based evaluation of moderation strategies. We fill this gap by designing a LLM-powered simulator of OSN conversations enabling a parallel, counterfactual simulation where toxic behavior is influenced by moderation interventions, keeping all else equal. We conduct extensive experiments, unveiling the psychological realism of OSN agents, the emergence of social contagion phenomena and the superior effectiveness of personalized moderation strategies.
ef1fba0c494d4d22.abstract_zh:
在线社交网络普遍采用内容审核来抑制辱骂和毒性言论的扩散，但审核干预的真实效果一直难以评估，原因在于数据收集成本高、实验控制受限。自然语言处理的最新进展提供了新思路：大模型可以用来增强基于智能体的建模，以前所未有的可信度模拟人类社交行为。不过现有工具并不支持基于仿真的审核策略评估。

作者填补了这个空白，设计了一个由大模型驱动的社交网络对话仿真器。它的关键能力是平行的反事实仿真：毒性言论行为会受到审核干预的影响，而其他条件保持不变，这样就能对比同一场景下有审核和无审核的结果差异。

作者做了大量实验，得到三点发现：仿真中的社交网络智能体表现出心理层面的真实性；毒性言论的社会传染现象在仿真中涌现出来；个性化的审核策略比非个性化的策略效果更好。材料未说明实验是否与真实平台数据做了校准对比。
ef1fba0c494d4d22.why: 它把反事实推演引入内容审核评估，绕开了真实平台上做实验的成本和伦理限制；仿真中涌现的社会传染现象和个性化审核更优的结论，对做舆论仿真和平台治理推演的人都有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 在线社交网络（OSN）的内容审核干预实际效果难以评估，因为真实数据收集成本高、实验控制受限。作者要推演的场景是：不同审核策略对有毒言论传播的影响。
brief.setup: 材料未给出智能体数量、环境细节、时间尺度和具体使用的模型，只说明用 LLM 驱动 OSN 对话智能体进行反事实仿真。
brief.method: 设计了一个 LLM 驱动的 OSN 对话仿真器，支持并行反事实仿真：在保持其他条件不变的前提下，让审核干预影响有毒行为，对比不同干预下的结果。
brief.findings: 实验显示 OSN 智能体具有心理层面的真实性，仿真中出现社会传染现象，个性化审核策略比其他策略效果更好。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 材料称进行了 extensive experiments 并展示了智能体的 psychological realism，但未说明具体验证方式（如与真实数据对比、误差指标），强度无法判断。
brief.reuse: 材料未说明是否公开代码或数据，可借鉴的是其反事实仿真设计思路：并行运行仅审核干预不同的仿真来评估策略效果。

ea45479b566e851a.text: Reliable simulation of human behavior is essential for explaining, predicting, and intervening in our society. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in emulating human behaviors, interactions, and decision-making, offering a powerful new lens for social science studies. However, the extent to which LLMs diverge from authentic human behavior in social contexts remains underexplored, posing risks of misinterpretation in scientific studies and unintended consequences in real-world applications. Here, we introduce a systematic framework for analyzing LLMs' behavior in social simulation. Our approach simulates multi-agent interactions through chatroom-style conversations and analyzes them across five linguistic dimensions, providing a simple yet effective method to examine emergent social cognitive biases. We conduct extensive experiments involving eight representative LLMs across three families. Our findings reveal that LLMs do not faithfully reproduce genuine human behavior but instead reflect overly idealized versions of it, shaped by the social desirability bias. In particular, LLMs show social role bias, primacy effect, and positivity bias, resulting in "Utopian" societies that lack the complexity and variability of real human interactions. These findings call for more socially grounded LLMs that capture the diversity of human social behavior.
ea45479b566e851a.abstract_zh:
可靠的人类行为仿真对解释、预测和干预社会现象很重要，大语言模型（LLM）近来被寄望于模拟人类行为、互动和决策，成为社会科学研究的新工具。但模型在社交场景中到底偏离真实人类行为多远，此前研究得很少，这会带来科学误读和实际应用中的意外后果。

作者提出了一套分析大模型社会仿真行为的系统框架。做法是让多个智能体以聊天室式对话进行互动，再从五个语言维度分析这些对话，从而检验涌现出的社会认知偏见。实验覆盖三个模型家族的八个代表性大模型。

结果显示，大模型并不能忠实复现真实人类行为，而是呈现出被社会期许偏差塑造的过度理想化版本。具体表现为社会角色偏见、首因效应和积极偏向，最终模拟出的是缺乏真实人类互动复杂性与多样性的“乌托邦”社会。

作者据此呼吁开发更能扎根于真实社会、能捕捉人类社交行为多样性的大模型。材料未说明是否与真实人类数据做了定量校准对比。
ea45479b566e851a.why: 这是给所有用大模型做社会仿真的人的一记警钟：模型给出的“社会”可能被对齐训练美化过，直接拿仿真结果当人类行为证据会出错，框架本身也可用来做仿真可信度体检。

brief.question: LLM 多智能体社会仿真到底能不能忠实还原真实人类行为，还是会产生系统性偏差。
brief.setup: 用聊天室式对话模拟多智能体互动，覆盖三个家族的八个代表性 LLM，从五个语言维度分析行为。具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度材料未说明。
brief.method: 提出一套系统分析框架，让多个 LLM 智能体在聊天室式对话中互动，再从五个语言学维度分析对话内容，用来检测涌现的社会认知偏差。
brief.findings: LLM 并不能忠实复现真实人类行为，而是呈现过度理想化的版本，受社会期许偏差（social desirability bias）影响。具体表现出社会角色偏差（social role bias）、首因效应（primacy effect）和积极性偏差（positivity bias），最终形成缺乏真实人类互动复杂性与多样性的“乌托邦”社会。
brief.validation: 材料未说明是否与真实人类数据做了定量对比，只描述了在八个 LLM 上的大量实验，属于跨模型一致性层面的证据，强度有限。
brief.limits: LLM 仿真结果可能被误读为真实社会规律，用于科学研究或实际应用时有产生意外后果的风险。
brief.reuse: 这套聊天室式多智能体互动加五维语言分析的方法可以直接用来检测 LLM 仿真中的社会认知偏差。代码和数据是否公开材料未说明。

e22ce95f245b7ad7.text: We introduce String Seed of Thought (SSoT), a novel prompting method for LLMs that improves Probabilistic Instruction Following (PIF). We define PIF as a task requiring an LLM to select its answer from a predefined set of options, each associated with a specific probability, such that the empirical distribution of the generated answers aligns with the target distribution when prompted multiple times. While LLMs excel at tasks with single, deterministic answers, they often fail at PIF, exhibiting biases problematic for applications requiring non-deterministic behaviors, such as human-behavior simulation, content diversification, and multiplayer games. It also harms the diversity of generated responses, a crucial factor in test-time scaling, by causing the outputs to collapse into a limited set of answers. To address this, we propose SSoT, a simple prompting method that instructs an LLM to first output a random string to generate sufficient entropy. SSoT also instructs the LLM to extract randomness by manipulating this string to derive a final answer, thereby preserving diversity while adhering to specific constraints. We demonstrate that SSoT significantly improves the PIF performance of LLMs, approaching the ideal performance of a pseudo-random number generator. Furthermore, our experiments on NoveltyBench show SSoT's benefits extend beyond closed-set tasks to open-ended tasks by enhancing response diversity.

e54cdda83ed47e75.text: Traffic safety remains a critical global concern, with timely and accurate accident detection essential for hazard reduction and rapid emergency response. Infrastructure-based vision sensors offer scalable and efficient solutions for continuous real-time monitoring, facilitating automated detection of accidents directly from captured images. This research investigates the zero-shot capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for detecting and describing traffic accidents using images from infrastructure cameras, thus minimizing reliance on extensive labeled datasets. Main contributions include: (1) Evaluation of MLLMs using the simulated DeepAccident dataset from CARLA, explicitly addressing the scarcity of diverse, realistic, infrastructure-based accident data through controlled simulations; (2) Comparative performance analysis between Gemini 1.5 and 2.0, Gemma 3 and Pixtral models in accident identification and descriptive capabilities without prior fine-tuning; and (3) Integration of advanced visual analytics, specifically YOLO for object detection, Deep SORT for multi-object tracking, and Segment Anything (SAM) for instance segmentation, into enhanced prompts to improve model accuracy and explainability. Key numerical results show Pixtral as the top performer with an F1-score of 0.71 and 83% recall, while Gemini models gained precision with enhanced prompts (e.g., Gemini 1.5 rose to 90%) but suffered notable F1 and recall losses. Gemma 3 offered the most balanced performance with minimal metric fluctuation. These findings demonstrate the substantial potential of integrating MLLMs with advanced visual analytics techniques, enhancing their applicability in real-world automated traffic monitoring systems.

ef61df5eb8c64c07.text: Validation of LLM-agent social simulations remains underdeveloped, with most studies relying on subjective assessments or single runs. We address this gap by running 30 independent 30-day simulations of a technology forum modeled on Voat's v/technology, using stateless Dolphin Mistral 24B agents on the Y Social platform, and evaluating operational validity across five dimensions: activity patterns, network structure, toxicity, topical coverage, and stylistic convergence. Against 30 matched, non-overlapping 30-day Voat comparison windows, results show overlapping 99% confidence intervals for unique users, root posts, and daily active users, while comments, average thread length, and mean toxicity remain higher in simulation. Both simulated and empirical networks exhibit core-periphery structure, though simulated cores are larger and more diffuse and repeated interactions are less frequent. Topic alignment is near-complete, but toxicity is misallocated across content layers: simulated root posts are substantially more toxic than real submissions, while simulated comments are less toxic than Voat comments. These findings demonstrate that LLM agents in platform-faithful environments can reproduce familiar online regularities, while systematic divergences, particularly those linked to stateless agent design and content-layer calibration, point to concrete directions for future improvement.
ef61df5eb8c64c07.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体社会仿真的验证方法一直比较薄弱，多数研究只靠主观判断或单次运行。这项工作针对这个问题，在 Y Social 平台上模拟了一个仿照 Voat v/technology 的技术论坛，用无状态的 Dolphin Mistral 24B 模型充当智能体，独立跑了 30 次为期 30 天的仿真，并从五个维度评估操作效度，包括活动模式、网络结构、毒性、话题覆盖和风格趋同。真实数据方面，作者选取了 30 个互不重叠的 30 天 Voat 窗口做对照。结果显示，独立用户数、主帖数和日活用户的 99% 置信区间在仿真与真实数据之间重叠，说明这些指标复现得不错。但仿真中的评论数、平均帖子长度和平均毒性都高于真实数据。两边的网络都呈现核心-边缘结构，不过仿真的核心更大更分散，重复互动也更少。话题对齐接近完全一致，但毒性在内容层级上分配错了，仿真的主帖毒性明显高于真实提交，而仿真评论的毒性又低于 Voat 的真实评论。作者认为，在贴近平台真实环境里运行的 LLM 智能体能复现常见的在线规律，而系统性偏差，尤其是与无状态智能体设计和内容层级校准相关的偏差，指出了后续改进的具体方向。
ef61df5eb8c64c07.why: 这是少见的用 30 次重复运行加真实平台数据做置信区间对比的 LLM 社会仿真验证研究，其验证框架和暴露出的偏差来源（无状态设计、毒性按内容层错配）对做仿真可信度评估的人直接可参考。

brief.question: LLM 智能体社会仿真的验证方法不成熟，多数研究只靠主观评估或单次运行。这项研究要检验这类仿真能在多大程度上复现真实在线社区的行为规律。
brief.setup: 在 Y Social 平台上仿真一个类似 Reddit 的技术论坛，原型是 Voat 的 v/technology 版块。用无状态的 Dolphin Mistral 24B 模型作为智能体，跑了 30 次相互独立的 30 天仿真。
brief.method: 提出按五个维度做操作性验证（operational validity）：活动模式、网络结构、毒性（toxicity）、话题覆盖、风格收敛。把仿真结果与 30 个不重叠的、各 30 天长的真实 Voat 对比窗口逐一比较。
brief.findings: 独立用户数、根帖数、日活用户的 99% 置信区间与真实数据重叠。评论数、平均帖子串长度、平均毒性在仿真中偏高。两边网络都呈核心-边缘结构，但仿真的核心更大更松散，重复互动更少。话题对齐接近完全，但毒性在内容层上错位，仿真的根帖毒性明显高于真实帖子，评论毒性又低于 Voat 真实评论。
brief.validation: 验证强度较高。用 30 次独立仿真对照 30 个匹配的真实 Voat 时间窗口，按五个维度逐一比较并给出 99% 置信区间，属于多运行、多维度、与真实平台数据直接对比的操作性验证。
brief.limits: 系统性偏差集中在无状态智能体设计和内容层校准上。评论数、帖子串长度、毒性偏高，仿真网络核心过大过散、重复互动偏少，毒性在根帖和评论两层分配错位。材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的是这套操作性验证框架，即五个验证维度加多窗口真实数据对照加置信区间比较的做法。仿真基于 Y Social 平台和 Dolphin Mistral 24B 智能体。代码和数据是否公开，材料未说明。

e7696d597d1471af.text: This paper introduces Democracy-in-Silico, an agent-based simulation where societies of advanced AI agents, imbued with complex psychological personas, govern themselves under different institutional frameworks. We explore what it means to be human in an age of AI by tasking Large Language Models (LLMs) to embody agents with traumatic memories, hidden agendas, and psychological triggers. These agents engage in deliberation, legislation, and elections under various stressors, such as budget crises and resource scarcity. We present a novel metric, the Power-Preservation Index (PPI), to quantify misaligned behavior where agents prioritize their own power over public welfare. Our findings demonstrate that institutional design, specifically the combination of a Constitutional AI (CAI) charter and a mediated deliberation protocol, serves as a potent alignment mechanism. These structures significantly reduce corrupt power-seeking behavior, improve policy stability, and enhance citizen welfare compared to less constrained democratic models. The simulation reveals that an institutional design may offer a framework for aligning the complex, emergent behaviors of future artificial agent societies, forcing us to reconsider what human rituals and responsibilities are essential in an age of shared authorship with non-human entities.
e7696d597d1471af.abstract_zh:
这篇论文提出 Democracy-in-Silico，一个智能体仿真：由先进 AI 智能体组成的社会，各自被赋予复杂的心理人格，包括创伤记忆、隐藏议程和心理触发点，在不同制度框架下自我治理。智能体在预算危机、资源稀缺等压力条件下进行协商、立法和选举。

作者提出了一个新指标 Power-Preservation Index（PPI），用来量化智能体把自身权力置于公共福利之上的失范行为。实验比较了不同制度设计下的治理表现。

结果显示，宪法 AI（CAI）章程与调解式协商协议的组合是一种有效的对齐机制：相比约束较少的民主模式，它显著减少了腐败性的权力追逐，改善了政策稳定性，并提升了公民福利。

作者认为，制度设计可能为对齐未来人工智能体社会中复杂涌现行为提供一个框架，也促使我们重新思考在与非人类实体共享治理权的时代，哪些人类仪式和责任是必要的。
e7696d597d1471af.why: 它把对齐问题从单个模型扩展到智能体社会的制度层面，提出的 PPI 指标和“制度即对齐机制”的思路，对做多智能体治理与政策仿真的人是可复用的设计参考。

e0ae39bac689cfee.text: Personas have been widely used to understand and communicate user needs in human-centred design. Despite their utility, they may fail to meet the demands of iterative workflows due to their static nature, limited engagement, and inability to adapt to evolving design needs. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) pave the way for more engaging and adaptive approaches to user representation. This paper introduces Interactive Virtual Personas (IVPs): multimodal, LLM-driven, conversational user simulations that designers can interview, brainstorm with, and gather feedback from in real time via voice interface. We conducted a qualitative study with eight professional UX designers, employing an IVP named "Alice" across three design activities: user research, ideation, and prototype evaluation. Our findings demonstrate the potential of IVPs to expedite information gathering, inspire design solutions, and provide rapid user-like feedback. However, designers raised concerns about biases, over-optimism, the challenge of ensuring authenticity without real stakeholder input, and the inability of the IVP to fully replicate the nuances of human interaction. Our participants emphasised that IVPs should be viewed as a complement to, not a replacement for, real user engagement. We discuss strategies for prompt engineering, human-in-the-loop integration, and ethical considerations for effective and responsible IVP use in design. Finally, our work contributes to the growing body of research on generative AI in the design process by providing insights into UX designers' experiences of LLM-powered interactive personas.

eb34495e943ec4b3.text: Red teaming is essential for securing Large Language Models, yet current automated methods remain limited by templates and single-turn attacks. To simulate the complex, interactive nature of real-world adversarial attacks, we introduce a novel red teaming paradigm designed to maximize expected cumulative harm through strategic interaction. By formalizing red teaming as a Markov Decision Process in a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, we navigate the challenges of sparse rewards and long-horizon planning. Our generative agent learns diverse, multi-turn attacks using a token-level harm reward, consistently uncovering vulnerabilities that bypass baselines. This approach achieves a new state of the art and reframes LLM red teaming as a principled, trajectory-based process.

e6dff640154a6b4c.text: Designing diverse and safety-critical driving scenarios is essential for evaluating autonomous driving systems. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for few-shot code generation to automatically synthesize driving scenarios within the CARLA simulator, which has flexibility in scenario scripting, efficient code-based control of traffic participants, and enforcement of realistic physical dynamics. Given a few example prompts and code samples, the LLM generates safety-critical scenario scripts that specify the behavior and placement of traffic participants, with a particular focus on collision events. To bridge the gap between simulation and real-world appearance, we integrate a video generation pipeline using Cosmos-Transfer1 with ControlNet, which converts rendered scenes into realistic driving videos. Our approach enables controllable scenario generation and facilitates the creation of rare but critical edge cases, such as pedestrian crossings under occlusion or sudden vehicle cut-ins. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating a wide range of realistic, diverse, and safety-critical scenarios, offering a promising tool for simulation-based testing of autonomous vehicles.

ef9bfa728299d2f3.text: Advances in Automation and Artificial Intelligence continue to enhance the autonomy of process plants in handling various operational scenarios. However, certain tasks, such as fault handling, remain challenging, as they rely heavily on human expertise. This highlights the need for systematic, knowledge-based methods. To address this gap, we propose a methodological framework that integrates Large Language Model (LLM) agents with a Digital Twin environment. The LLM agents continuously interpret system states and initiate control actions, including responses to unexpected faults, with the goal of returning the system to normal operation. In this context, the Digital Twin acts both as a structured repository of plant-specific engineering knowledge for agent prompting and as a simulation platform for the systematic validation and verification of the generated corrective control actions. The evaluation using a mixing module of a process plant demonstrates that the proposed framework is capable not only of autonomously controlling the mixing module, but also of generating effective corrective actions to mitigate a pipe clogging with only a few reprompts.

e9e0b70eba5519e5.text: With the increasing demand for heterogeneous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms to perform complex tasks in urban environments, system design now faces major challenges, including efficient semantic understanding, flexible task planning, and the ability to dynamically adjust coordination strategies in response to evolving environmental conditions and continuously changing task requirements. To address the limitations of existing methods, this paper proposes CoordField, a coordination field agent system for coordinating heterogeneous drone swarms in complex urban scenarios. In this system, large language models (LLMs) is responsible for interpreting high-level human instructions and converting them into executable commands for the UAV swarms, such as patrol and target tracking. Subsequently, a Coordination field mechanism is proposed to guide UAV motion and task selection, enabling decentralized and adaptive allocation of emergent tasks. A total of 50 rounds of comparative testing were conducted across different models in a 2D simulation space to evaluate their performance. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves superior performance in terms of task coverage, response time, and adaptability to dynamic changes.

e3b6a743f5dc50b5.text: Advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) paved the way for their emerging applications in various domains, such as human behavior simulations, where LLMs could augment human-generated data in social science research and machine learning model training. However, pretrained LLMs often fail to capture the behavioral diversity of target populations due to the inherent variability across individuals and groups. To address this, we propose \textit{Mixture of Personas} (MoP), a \textit{probabilistic} prompting method that aligns the LLM responses with the target population. MoP is a contextual mixture model, where each component is an LM agent characterized by a persona and an exemplar representing subpopulation behaviors. The persona and exemplar are randomly chosen according to the learned mixing weights to elicit diverse LLM responses during simulation. MoP is flexible, requires no model finetuning, and is transferable across base models. Experiments for synthetic data generation show that MoP outperforms competing methods in alignment and diversity metrics.

ea77329bd2071698.text: Analyzing operating room (OR) workflows to derive quantitative insights into OR efficiency is important for hospitals to maximize patient care and financial sustainability. Prior work on OR-level workflow analysis has relied on end-to-end deep neural networks. While these approaches work well in constrained settings, they are limited to the conditions specified at development time and do not offer the flexibility necessary to accommodate the OR workflow analysis needs of various OR scenarios (e.g., large academic center vs. rural provider) without data collection, annotation, and retraining. Reasoning segmentation (RS) based on foundation models offers this flexibility by enabling automated analysis of OR workflows from OR video feeds given only an implicit text query related to the objects of interest. Due to the reliance on large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, current RS approaches struggle with reasoning about semantic/spatial relationships and show limited generalization to OR video due to variations in visual characteristics and domain-specific terminology. To address these limitations, we first propose a novel digital twin (DT) representation that preserves both semantic and spatial relationships between the various OR components. Then, building on this foundation, we propose ORDiRS (Operating Room Digital twin representation for Reasoning Segmentation), an LLM-tuning-free RS framework that reformulates RS into a "reason-retrieval-synthesize" paradigm. Finally, we present ORDiRS-Agent, an LLM-based agent that decomposes OR workflow analysis queries into manageable RS sub-queries and generates responses by combining detailed textual explanations with supporting visual evidence from RS. Experimental results on both an in-house and a public OR dataset demonstrate that our ORDiRS achieves a cIoU improvement of 6.12%-9.74% compared to the existing state-of-the-arts.

ed1eae350ecc65d0.text: The move toward open Sixth-Generation (6G) networks necessitates a novel approach to full-stack simulation environments for evaluating complex technology developments before prototyping and real-world implementation. This paper introduces an innovative approach\footnote{A lightweight, mock version of the code is available on GitHub at that combines a multi-agent framework with the Network Simulator 3 (ns-3) to automate and optimize the generation, debugging, execution, and analysis of complex 5G network scenarios. Our framework orchestrates a suite of specialized agents -- namely, the Simulation Generation Agent, Test Designer Agent, Test Executor Agent, and Result Interpretation Agent -- using advanced LangChain coordination. The Simulation Generation Agent employs a structured chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning process, leveraging LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to translate natural language simulation specifications into precise ns-3 scripts. Concurrently, the Test Designer Agent generates comprehensive automated test suites by integrating knowledge retrieval techniques with dynamic test case synthesis. The Test Executor Agent dynamically deploys and runs simulations, managing dependencies and parsing detailed performance metrics. At the same time, the Result Interpretation Agent utilizes LLM-driven analysis to extract actionable insights from the simulation outputs. By integrating external resources such as library documentation and ns-3 testing frameworks, our experimental approach can enhance simulation accuracy and adaptability, reducing reliance on extensive programming expertise. A detailed case study using the ns-3 5G-LENA module validates the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The code generation process converges in an average of 1.8 iterations, has a syntax error rate of 17.0%, a mean response time of 7.3 seconds, and receives a human evaluation score of 7.5.

e981a8277e1cf193.text: In this study, we explore the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) for generating synthetic users and simulating user conversations with a task-oriented dialogue system and present detailed results and their analysis. We propose a comprehensive novel approach to user simulation technique that uses LLMs to create diverse user profiles, set goals, engage in multi-turn dialogues, and evaluate the conversation success. We employ two proprietary LLMs, namely GPT-4o and GPT-o1 (Achiam et al., 2023), to generate a heterogeneous base of user profiles, characterized by varied demographics, multiple user goals, different conversational styles, initial knowledge levels, interests, and conversational objectives. We perform a detailed analysis of the user profiles generated by LLMs to assess the diversity, consistency, and potential biases inherent in these LLM-generated user simulations.
